updates.note: Management reaffirmed the high single-digit top line growth guidance for FY27.
updates.quote: Think we should stick on to the high single-digit growth for the full year.

updates.note: Management reaffirmed the R&D spend guidance.
updates.quote: We have already guided for the annual number. And I think we should be able to meet those numbers.

updates.note: Management reiterated expectation for Organon acquisition completion in Q4 of FY27.
updates.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 of financial year '27
